work_packages.title: Probabilistic multi-sensor diagnosis of the field state
objectives: Acquire and harmonise Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 optical, PlanetScope, ERA5 and field-observation data into a unified EO data layer.
Estimate root-zone soil moisture and crop water status as a calibrated posterior with honest uncertainty via Route B homogeneous-patch proxy and Route A Bayesian hierarchical model.

tasks.title: Acquire and harmonise multi-sensor EO and meteorological data
Implement Route B homogeneous-patch proxy architecture
Calibrate Bayesian hierarchical model for latent field state estimation

deliverables.title: Multi-sensor data harmonisation and diagnostic model report

work_packages.title: Uncertainty-aware decision engine and demonstrator integration
objectives: Calibrate AquaCrop with an honest parameter posterior and implement uncertainty-aware water-use-efficiency decision recommendations under weather ensemble uncertainty.
Integrate diagnostic and decision outputs into a standalone research demonstrator (web MVP, TRL 3-4).

tasks.title: Calibrate uncertainty-aware AquaCrop model with parameter posterior
Implement counterfactual irrigation simulation over weather ensembles
Develop and integrate research demonstrator web MVP

deliverables.title: Decision engine and research demonstrator report

work_packages.title: Field validation, ground truth and uncertainty calibration
objectives: Collect non-destructive physiological ground truth on Hungarian tomato farms via AgroVIR to validate the diagnostic branch.
Assess uncertainty calibration against the 90% prediction interval target and test the Route B patch-covariation assumption via co-located seasonal campaign.

tasks.title: Design and run field validation protocol on tomato farms
Assess uncertainty calibration and patch-covariation assumption

deliverables.title: Field validation and uncertainty calibration report

work_packages.title: Training, supervision and two-way transfer of knowledge
objectives: Deliver a jointly prepared Career Development Plan and structured transferable-skills training covering MSCA-PF mandatory dimensions.
Facilitate two-way transfer of knowledge between the fellow and the host's geoinformatics and remote-sensing group.

tasks.title: Prepare and review Career Development Plan jointly with fellow

work_packages.title: Dissemination, exploitation, communication and management
objectives: Deliver open-access publications, a FAIR data management plan, and an open-data/model release aligned with MSCA-PF open-science requirements.
Communicate project results to the geoinformatics community and Hungarian tomato growers via AgroVIR, and manage project coordination and ethics oversight.

tasks.title: Prepare data management plan and open-data/model releases
Develop communication and dissemination materials for target audiences

edges.derivation: T1-02 produces Route B homogeneous-patch proxy field state estimates; T2-01 calibrates AquaCrop with the resulting parameter posterior — the 'parameter posterior' phrasing in T2-01 directly references T1-02/T1-03 outputs (WP1 objectives, WP2 T2-01 title)

T1-03 calibrates the Bayesian hierarchical model producing the latent field state posterior; T2-01 explicitly requires a 'parameter posterior' to calibrate AquaCrop, which is the output of T1-03 (WP1 objective 2, WP2 T2-01 title)
T3-03 explicitly tests the 'Route B patch-covariation assumption' introduced by T1-02; T3-03 cannot assess this assumption without T1-02 outputs (WP3 objective 2, WP3 T3-03 title, WP1 T1-02 title)

T3-03 assesses 'uncertainty calibration against the 90% prediction interval target', which requires the uncertainty estimates produced by T1-03's Bayesian hierarchical model (WP3 objective 2, WP3 T3-03 title, WP1 T1-03 title)

T5-02 develops dissemination materials 'for target audiences' (geoinformatics community and tomato growers); the research demonstrator web MVP produced by T2-03 is a primary result to be communicated (WP5 objective 2, WP2 T2-03 title)

T5-02 disseminates project results including validation findings; T3-03 produces the uncertainty calibration and patch-covariation assessment results that constitute key scientific outputs for dissemination (WP5 objective 2, WP3 T3-03 title)

dependency_analysis_notes.algorithm: Kahn topological sort for cycle detection; longest-path dynamic programming over DAG for critical path

dependency_analysis_notes.critical_path_trace: T1-02 (dist=0) → T3-03 (dist=1, via data_input) → T5-02 (dist=2, via data_input); alternative co-equal path T1-03→T3-03→T5-02 has identical length; T1-02 selected as path head as it appears first in node enumeration order
